notes: Two isnads meet at Sufyan; the tail runs to Ibn Mas'ud, the one who speaks («قال كنا نصومه ثم ترك»)
«أن الأشعث بن قيس، دخل على عبد الله» is a scene: Ash'ath acts and is not a link; the ruling is whether the Companion's words inside the encounter are the report's source
«واللفظ له» is an editor gloss and is left out
